answers.description: We used a bottom-up approach that targets the weakness of the MCC metric. After fine-tuning a LightGBM classifier with WMT25's data sets and applying data filtering strategies and CometKiwi filtering, we used multifactorial phraseology heuristics based on corpus linguistics and collocation measures: entropy, logDice, MI filtering, etc. We also used an LLM-as-a-judge strategy, further specializing the prompt by highlighting the disagreements between error-free segments and the classifier's predictions. Language pairs: eng_Latn-bel_Cyrl, eng_Latn-deu_Latn, eng_Latn-rus_Cyrl, eng_Latn-ukr_Cyrl, eng_Latn-zho_Hans, eng_Latn-zho_Hant_TW
